explanation_en: Shubman Gill hit a boundary off SP Narine! Your player Shubman Gill gained +7.0 points, taking his total to 36.0. Your team's total points increased to 147.5, but your simulated rank dropped from 805 to 1013 because other teams in the pool gained more points on this ball.
explanation_hi: Boss, Shubman Gill ne SP Narine ko chauka jad diya! Aapke player Shubman Gill ko +7.0 points mile, aur unka total 36.0 ho gaya. Aapki team ka total 147.5 ho gaya, par aapki rank 805 se 1013 par slip ho gayi kyunki rival teams ne aur points bator liye is ball par.
watch_next_en: Watch out, Shubman Gill needs just 4 more runs for the 30-run milestone bonus!
watch_next_hi: Dekhte raho, Shubman Gill ko 30-run milestone bonus ke liye bas 4 runs aur chahiye!
